text_en: Jude, a servant of Jesus Christ and brother of James, To those who are called, who are beloved in God the Father and kept safe for Jesus Christ:
text_cn: 耶稣基督的仆人，雅各伯的兄弟犹达，致书给在天主父内蒙爱，为耶稣基督而保存的蒙召者。

text_en: May mercy, peace, and love be yours in abundance.
text_cn: 愿仁慈、平安、爱情丰富地赐予你们。

text_en: Beloved, while eagerly preparing to write to you about the salvation we share, I find it necessary to write and appeal to you to contend for the faith that was once for all entrusted to the saints.
text_cn: 亲爱的，我早已切望给你们写信，讨论我们共享的救恩；但现在不得不给你们写信，劝勉你们应奋斗，维护从前一次而永远传与圣徒的信仰。

text_en: For certain intruders have stolen in among you, people who long ago were designated for this condemnation as ungodly, who pervert the grace of our God into licentiousness and deny our only Master and Lord, Jesus Christ.
text_cn: 因为有些早已被注定要受这审判的人，潜入你们中间；他们是邪恶的人，竟把我们天主的恩宠，变为放纵情欲的机会，并否认我们独一的主宰和主耶稣基督。

text_en: Now I desire to remind you, though you are fully informed, that the Lord, who once for all saved a people out of the land of Egypt, afterward destroyed those who did not believe.
text_cn: 虽然你们一次而永远知道这一切，但我仍愿提醒你们：主固然由埃及地救出了百姓，随后却把那些不信的人消灭了；

text_en: And the angels who did not keep their own position, but left their proper dwelling, he has kept in eternal chains in deepest darkness for the judgment of the great day.
text_cn: 至于那些没有保持自己尊位，而离弃自己居所的天使，主也用永远的锁链，把他们拘留在幽暗中，以等候那伟大日子的审判；

text_en: Likewise, Sodom and Gomorrah and the surrounding cities, which, in the same manner as they, indulged in sexual immorality and pursued unnatural lust, serve as an example by undergoing a punishment of eternal fire.
text_cn: 同样，索多玛和哈摩辣及其附近的城市，因为也和他们一样恣意行淫，随从逆性的肉欲，至今受着永火的刑罚，作为鉴戒。

text_en: Yet in the same way these dreamers also defile the flesh, reject authority, and slander the glorious ones.
text_cn: 可是这些作梦的人照样玷污肉身，拒绝主权者，亵渎众尊荣者。

text_en: But when the archangel Michael contended with the devil and disputed about the body of Moses, he did not dare to bring a condemnation of slander against him, but said, “The Lord rebuke you! ”
text_cn: 当总领天使弥额尔，为了梅瑟的尸体和魔鬼激烈争辩时，尚且不敢以侮辱的言词下判决，而只说：“愿主叱责你！”

text_en: But these people slander whatever they do not understand, and they are destroyed by those things that, like irrational animals, they know by instinct.
text_cn: 这些人却不然，凡他们所不明白的事就亵渎，而他们按本性所体验的事，却像无理性的畜牲一样，就在这些事上败坏自己。

text_en: Woe to them! For they go the way of Cain, and abandon themselves to Balaam’s error for the sake of gain, and perish in Korah’s rebellion.
text_cn: 这些人是有祸的！因为他们走了加音的路，为图利而自陷于巴郎的错误，并因科辣黑一样的叛逆，而自取灭亡。

text_en: These are blemishes on your love-feasts, while they feast with you without fear, feeding themselves. They are waterless clouds carried along by the winds; autumn trees without fruit, twice dead, uprooted;
text_cn: 这些人是你们爱宴上的污点，他们同人宴乐，毫无廉耻，只顾自肥；他们像无水的浮云，随风飘荡；又像晚秋不结果实，死了又死，该连根拔出来的树木；

text_en: wild waves of the sea, casting up the foam of their own shame; wandering stars, for whom the deepest darkness has been reserved forever.
text_cn: 像海里的怒涛，四下飞溅他们无耻的白沫；又像出轨的行星，为他们所存留的，乃是直到永远的黑暗的幽冥。

text_en: It was also about these that Enoch, in the seventh generation from Adam, prophesied, saying, “See, the Lord is coming with ten thousands of his holy ones,
text_cn: 针对这些人，亚当后第七代圣祖哈诺客也曾预言说：“看，主带着他千万的圣者降来，

text_en: to execute judgment on all, and to convict everyone of all the deeds of ungodliness that they have committed in such an ungodly way, and of all the harsh things that ungodly sinners have spoken against him. ”
text_cn: 要审判众人，指证一切恶人所行的一切恶事，和邪辟的人所说的一切亵渎他的言语。”

text_en: These are grumblers and malcontents; they indulge their own lusts; they are bombastic in speech, flattering people to their own advantage.
text_cn: 这些人好出怨言，不满命运；按照自己的私欲行事，他们的口好说大话，为了利益而奉承他人。

text_en: But you, beloved, must remember the predictions of the apostles of our Lord Jesus Christ;
text_cn: 但是你们，亲爱的，你们要记得我们的主耶稣基督的宗徒所预言过的话，

text_en: for they said to you, “In the last time there will be scoffers, indulging their own ungodly lusts. ”
text_cn: 他们曾向你们说过：“到末期，必有一些好嘲弄人的人，按照他们个人邪恶的私欲行事。”

text_en: It is these worldly people, devoid of the Spirit, who are causing divisions.
text_cn: 这就是那些好分党分派，属于血肉，没有圣神的人。

text_en: But you, beloved, build yourselves up on your most holy faith; pray in the Holy Spirit;
text_cn: 可是你们，亲爱的，你们要把自己建筑在你们至圣的信德上，在圣神内祈祷；

text_en: keep yourselves in the love of God; look forward to the mercy of our Lord Jesus Christ that leads to eternal life.
text_cn: 这样保存你们自己常在天主的爱内，期望赖我们的主耶稣基督的仁慈，入于永生。

text_en: And have mercy on some who are wavering;
text_cn: 对那些怀疑不信的人，你们要说服；

text_en: save others by snatching them out of the fire; and have mercy on still others with fear, hating even the tunic defiled by their bodies.
text_cn: 对另一些人，你们要拯救，把他们从火里拉出来；但对另一些人，你们固然要怜悯，可是应存戒惧的心，甚至连他们肉身所玷污了的内衣，也要憎恶。

text_en: Now to him who is able to keep you from falling, and to make you stand without blemish in the presence of his glory with rejoicing,
text_cn: 愿那能保护你们不失足，并能叫你们无瑕地，在欢跃中立在他光荣面前的，

text_en: to the only God our Savior, through Jesus Christ our Lord, be glory, majesty, power, and authority, before all time and now and forever. Amen.
text_cn: 惟一的天主，我们的救主，藉我们的主耶稣基督，获享光荣、尊威、主权和能力，于万世之前，现在，至于无穷之世。阿们。
